requirements.expectation: Product CLI health exits zero without any Bot credential and prints a health payload.
Product CLI list exits zero and echoes all five trusted-team fixture Bot UUIDs.
Product CLI get exits zero and echoes the requested fixture Bot UUID.
Product CLI discover exits zero and returns the CS fixture Bot UUID for the CS fixture-name query.
Product CLI visibility get exposes the original value; set public takes effect and an exact restore returns to the original value.
Product CLI connect exits zero and returns JSON with the fixture Bot UUID and a non-empty token.
Product CLI onboard --web exits zero, prints a registration URL containing the probe name, and registers no Bot.
Product CLI onboard persists a freshly registered temporary agent with its registered id, onboarded true and matching name; the agent reads back once and is deleted exactly once, then reads 404.

Product CLI update-status exits zero and prints a Status acknowledgement; the independent Bot read before and after the broadcast shows the registry record unchanged (presence broadcast is echoed, not retained); the best-effort busy restore exits zero.

Product CLI create-group creates the exact PM/ENG Group; get-group echoes its exact Group ID and owned participants; the created group is removed by an exact creator-scoped HTTP DELETE and reads back 404.

Product CLI chat exits zero with --detach (or a blocking retry) and returns a JSON run/session handle; the original release order paired CEO<->PM in friends.sh first, so the owned-local executor bootstraps the same prerequisite friendship pair in-case and records both admissions.
Product CLI list-groups returns the paginated shape {items, returned, total, has_more} with returned equal to the item count.
After the case admits exactly one CEO-ENG friendship, product CLI friend list exits zero and contains the ENG fixture Bot UUID.
